cases.name: close_same_phase
cases.note: Close angles below the declared 12 deg peak-separation threshold; non-destructive mixture.

cases.name: separated_balanced
cases.note: Separated same-range angles with comparable amplitudes.

cases.name: separated_unequal
cases.note: Separated angles but a weak second scatterer; tests leakage/conditioning.

cases.name: close_destructive
cases.note: Negative case: close equal phasors initially cancel; unresolved mixture is not assumed equivalent.

cases.name: coincident_destructive
cases.note: Limit case: exactly coincident opposite phasors cancel in every array channel; both routes should abstain.

model.estimator: array-only Bartlett peaks + conventional beamforming + unwrap + fixed geometric cos(beta)
model.guard: minimum beamformed magnitude >= 5.0x declared complex-noise sigma
model.merge_rule: strongest detected array-only angle peak; one beamformed phasor
